Independent acceptance gates

Each gate needs its own platform-correct evidence. Partial, blocked or unverified behavior is not certified as passed. There is no completed new qualified Apple iteration to score and no new weighted software-quality score.

Camera, microphone, location and delegated iframesUnverified on current Apple targets

Synthetic Chromium fixtures and cancellation checks pass. Physical/native permission and cross-origin media/location behavior remain unverified.

WebRTC, WebSocket and WebTransport/QUICLocal controls verified; native scope incomplete

Exact text/binary WebSocket echoes and observed close; local RTC peer exercise; real HTTP/3 stream/datagram checks 5/5. Native cross-browser/media/QUIC proof remains pending.

DOM and WebAssemblyNative partial result; timeout retained

Six-file native summary 1,695/1,850; 3/6 files fully pass. WASM harness TIMEOUT. Complete native assertion report remains unrecovered.

WebGL, WebGPU and visible renderingLocal controls verified; Apple presentation pending

Two real Chromium WebGL captures; explicit software offscreen WebGPU at 3 resolutions. Default WebGPU had no adapter. No new native retained-canvas or matched Safari/Chrome visual proof.

Google/Apple mocks and real service workflowsReal authentication and sites unverified

Mock popups are labeled simulations. Actual authorized Google/Apple login and Lume workflows on Google, ChatGPT, X and YouTube remain unverified.

Six new Mac Release/restart/iPad iterations0/6 qualified cycles

Six native test files are not six Release iterations. No new Mac/iPad Release build or complete launch/restart cycle was verified in this continuation.

Same signed IPA and signing prerequisitesUnverified

No identical signed IPA hash/install/launch proof. Earlier recovery reported no valid signing identities; signing was not rechecked here. Native/Catalyst/simulator binaries do not prove identical IPA bytes.

Full Chromium idle mean 2.185%, p95 9.0%, budget p95 ≤3%. Blank controls also missed. No matched same-Mac Lume/Chrome resource verdict.

The historical 100-point rubric is preserved unchanged. Historical 17/100 coverage remains historical. Prepared patches, API existence, mocks, synthetic devices, a build or a local test percentage cannot substitute for the 98/100 Apple goal.
